title: The Ocean Dragon
prompt:
Character bible:
Children (draw these the same way on every page):
- Elliott, age 4–5, short straight light-brown hair; big gray-blue eyes; round cheeks; friendly adventurous expression, wearing medieval tunic with belt and boots or casual explorer outfit
- Colette, age 2–3, wavy brown hair in a top knot; large gray-blue eyes; soft cheeks, wearing whimsical princess-meets-adventurer dress with floral or heart motifs
Pets (draw these the same way on every page):
- Winnie, a Chihuahua–Pug mix, tan fur; upright ears; curled tail; small size
Keep these characters consistent. They represent specific real children. Do NOT replace them with generic children or idealized animated characters. Preserve their recognizable facial structure.

GLOBAL SAFETY (IMPORTANT):
- No object intersections or impossible overlaps.
- Clean occlusion: if objects overlap, the front object clearly covers the back object.
- No extra limbs, no duplicated faces, no merged hands/feet.
- Keep dragons anatomically clean: one head, two wings (if winged), four limbs, one tail.
- Keep shapes simple and readable for coloring.

Black-and-white children's coloring-book line art with clean black outlines on white, no shading, gray, gradients, shadows, or large filled-black areas; interiors open for coloring. Classic coloring-book illustration style with natural child proportions and clear facial expressions, not chibi. Full-page dynamic vertical composition with Elliott, Colette, and Winnie filling most of the lower two-thirds, key elements extending upward toward the top edge. Scene: wide sandy shore with Elliott and Colette standing at the water's edge, gentle ocean waves rolling toward them. A majestic ocean dragon rises gracefully from the sea, featuring fin-like wings, a long flowing body, and coral-shaped horns. Shoreline calm and spacious with broad, smooth wave lines, minimal internal detail, no face-like shapes or eye/mouth-like foam patterns in the water. Wave crests abstract and flowing. Simple, clean horizon line. Clear foreground, midground, and background separation using outlines only, balanced head-to-body proportions, expressive but restrained facial expressions, whimsical warm tone without exaggeration, characters fully visible and naturally interacting with the environment, medium-close shot cropped closely with heads, hands, or feet near page edges allowed, avoiding large blank spaces.

Use the attached character sheet reference images as the canonical identity and style.
